summary.text: Edwin Rivera, a Republican who grew up in Puerto Rico and lives in Newport News, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Virginia's 3rd District to Bobby Scott.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Army and has worked as a police officer.
His campaign website listed education reform, public safety, and opposing tolls on the Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Rivera grew up in Puerto Rico and lives in Newport News, Virginia.

He served in the U.S. Army, and the Virginia Mercury describes him as an Army veteran who served several combat tours in the Middle East and as a father of seven. Ballotpedia also lists police officer in his career experience.
Rivera became the Republican nominee without appearing on a primary ballot, after the August 4, 2026 Republican primary was canceled.
He received 24.0% of the vote to Bobby Scott's 72.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
